title: TRAY WITH VARIOUS COLLECTORS C...
reason: Title undersells a very large, carefully sorted bird card collection (several thousand cards, multiple 384-card runs in print and card-stock variants); series not identified, value depends on it.
findings: Much bigger than a tray. Photo 1 shows several cardboard boxes and a red-lidded box packed with what looks like several thousand loose cards, stacked in paper-banded bundles with rubber bands. Photo 2 shows the cards: rounded-corner, playing-card-size cards with painted wading birds (sandpipers, ibis, ducks) in landscape settings, with no printed text visible on the fronts. Photos 3 to 7 show the hand-written labels on the bundles: 'Series Birds Thin/Brown, Set (E)' in runs 1-96, 97-192, 193-288 and 289-384 (some marked Complete); 'Bird Studies Dark Brown print (C)' in the same four runs; 'Bird Studies Grey (D)' in the same four runs; 'Coppertone (E)' for 97-192, 193-288 and 289-384; 'SB Thick 193-288', 'SB/Thick/Lighter 193-288', '289-384 (SB) Thick'; 'Spare Coppertone & lighter brown'; and one wrapper noting 'of a series of 192 cards ... 97-192 ... Complete'. This looks like a specialist's multi-set collection of one 384-card bird card series, sorted by card stock (thin or thick) and print colour (dark brown, grey, coppertone), possibly with several complete runs. I could not identify the issuer or series from the photos, and a web search was not possible in this run, so the real value depends on which series it is.
condition: Cards look aged and cream-toned with edge toning; corners look intact on the loose sample in photo 2; many bundles are held with rubber bands that can mark or perish; the boxes are worn and torn; the face condition of the stacked cards cannot be seen.
rescore_note: Thousands of loose bird cards that visually match the Tuckfield's cards in the lot 430 albums, sorted into labelled 96-card runs covering 1 to 384 in several print and stock variants, some marked Complete. The series is common but the volume and sorting should reach the upper $80 to $200 band. General knowledge, no web check.
